metadata.name: Docker Volume Backup
metadata.description: One-shot Bash backup script for archiving a path from a Docker container's mounted volumes to timestamped .tar.gz files with optional container stop/start, retention cleanup, latest symlink support, dry-run mode, and automation-friendly exit codes.

items.name: backup_dir
items.title: Backup Directory
items.description: Host directory where timestamped backup files are written.

items.name: backup_container_path
items.title: Container Path
items.description: Container path to archive from the target container's mounted volumes.

items.name: helper_image
items.title: Helper Image
items.description: Temporary helper image used to read the target container's mounted volumes.

items.name: stop_container_during_backup
items.title: Stop Container
items.description: Stop the target container before backup for a more consistent filesystem snapshot.

items.name: start_container_after_backup
items.title: Restart After Backup
items.description: Start the container again after backup if this script stopped it.

items.name: retention_days
items.title: Retention Days
items.description: Delete matching backup files older than this many days. Use 0 to disable cleanup.

items.name: create_latest_symlink
items.title: Create Latest Symlink
items.description: Update a latest symlink next to the timestamped backup file.

items.name: dry_run
items.title: Dry Run
items.description: Print planned actions without writing backup files, stopping containers, or deleting old backups.
